features.name: Spells
features.description: Casts arcane spells from the wizard spell list, prepared from a spellbook. Intelligence determines bonus spells and spell save DCs.

features.name: Cantrips
features.description: Can prepare a number of 0-level spells each day, and can cast them repeatedly.

features.name: Arcane Bond
features.description: Forms a bond with either an object (amulet, ring, staff, wand, or weapon) or a familiar. A bonded object can be used once per day to cast any spell from the wizard's spellbook.

features.name: Arcane School
features.description: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining school powers and an additional spell slot per spell level, or become a universalist. Specialists must choose two opposition schools.

features.name: Scribe Scroll
features.description: Gains Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat.

features.name: Bonus Languages
features.description: May substitute Draconic for one of the bonus languages available from the character's race.

features.name: Spellbooks
features.description: Begins with a spellbook containing all 0-level spells and 3 plus Intelligence modifier 1st-level spells. Gains two new spells of any level he can cast each time he gains a wizard level.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.description: Gain a metamagic feat, item creation feat, or Spell Mastery. Another at every fifth level after 5th.
